name: Security scripts · Incident response toolkit (Windows + Linux)
description: Modular PowerShell and Bash playbooks for endpoint containment, investigation, eradication, and verification: phased incident response as code.
longDescription: A toolkit that packages incident-response workflows as repeatable scripts for Windows endpoints and Linux servers. Each phase: containment, investigation, eradication, recovery: has scoped entry points with parameters for host, user, timeframe, and scope. Structured logging supports post-incident review. Outputs are treated as sensitive forensic material suitable for regulated environments.
features: Phased Windows IR scripts with scoped parameters
Linux hunt scripts for multi-host triage
Quick-start guidance with prerequisites called out
Separation between containment and evidence collection steps
highlights: Bridges Windows endpoint and Linux server response workflows
Phased approach instead of one-off manual commands
challenges: IR automation is powerful; misuse can destroy evidence or cause downtime.
solutions: Documented prerequisites, scope flags, dry-run guidance, and explicit separation of destructive remediation from preservation steps.
security: Protect outputs: they may contain sensitive forensic data
Review commands before execution in regulated environments
Store tooling and logs with tier-0 access controls
